hits.snippet: # Centific Appoints Vasudevan Sundarababu as Chief Data and AI Officer ... (US and Canada) Digital technology services company Centific has appointed Vasudevan Sundarababu as its Chief Data and AI Officer. Sundarababu joined Centific in late 2021 as the Senior Vice President and head of Digital Engineering, bringing with him over 25 years of experience building AI and Data platforms. ... Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific, commented, “Vasu’s visionary leadership has been a game-changer for us. His promotion to Chief Data and AI Officer is strategic for the entire trajectory of our company. Under his guidance, I’m confident that Centific will not only continue to lead the market but also accelerate our growth and scale new innovations that will set industry benchmarks.”
